edition_angle: Focusing on gut microbiota-driven SCFA network disruption as a dual driver of intestinal barrier breakdown and neurocognitive impairment in aging.

assignments.angle: Investigating how high-fat diet and aging synergistically degrade Muribaculaceae-linked SCFA production, driving systemic inflammation and hippocampal cognitive deficits via intestinal barrier breakdown.
assignments.reason: This study offers a specific, causal biophysical and metabolic mechanism (Muribaculaceae-associated SCFA network loss driving LPS translocation and hippocampal deficits) within the under-represented Inner Garden spiral, avoiding broad epidemiological correlations or recent spiral over-concentrations.
